summary: A ride that starts while another is under way (a trigger's dart, then a slip in the same frame) now inherits that ride's hold on the transformer, and contacts wait while any ride is under way; before, the transformer stayed off for good and the hull froze mid-race (about 1 Slip Line race in 10 timed out). No ability changed.
why: Overnight stall trace for the Regatta flywheel (race judge: 8 timeouts in 96 races before, 0 after).
